title: Towards universal synthetic heterotrophy using a metabolic coordinator.
authors: Sullivan, Sean F; Shetty, Anuj; Bharadwaj, Tharun; Krishna, Naveen; Trivedi, Vikas D; Endalur Gopinarayanan, Venkatesh; Chappell, Todd C; Sellers, Daniel M; Pravin Kumar, R; Nair, Nikhil U
one_liner_zh: 该文利用分子建模研究Gal3p变体构象以激活GAL调控子，实现酵母合成异养代谢，但核心是代谢工程而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: Engineering the utilization of non-native substrates, or synthetic heterotrophy, in proven industrial microbes such as Saccharomyces cerevisiae represents an opportunity to valorize plentiful and renewable sources of carbon and energy as inputs to bioprocesses. We previously demonstrated that activation of the galactose (GAL) regulon, a regulatory structure used by this yeast to coordinate substrate utilization with biomass formation during growth on galactose, during growth on the non-native substrate xylose results in a vastly altered gene expression profile and faster growth compared with constitutive overexpression of the same heterologous catabolic pathway. However, this effort involved the creation of a xylose-inducible variant of Gal3p (Gal3p(Syn4.1)), the sensor protein of the GAL regulon, preventing this semi-synthetic regulon approach from being easily adapted to additional non-native substrates. Here, we report the construction of a variant Gal3p(MC) (metabolic coordinator) that exhibits robust GAL regulon activation in the presence of structurally diverse substrates and recapitulates the dynamics of the native system. Multiple molecular modeling studies suggest that Gal3p(MC) occupies conformational states corresponding to galactose-bound Gal3p in an inducer-independent manner. Using Gal3p(MC) to test a regulon approach to the assimilation of the non-native lignocellulosic sugars xylose, arabinose, and cellobiose yields higher growth rates and final cell densities when compared with a constitutive overexpression of the same set of catabolic genes. The subsequent demonstration of rapid and complete co-utilization of all three non-native substrates suggests that Gal3p(MC)-mediated dynamic global gene expression changes by GAL regulon activation may be universally beneficial for engineering synthetic heterotrophy.
abstract_zh: 在成熟的工业微生物（如酿酒酵母 *Saccharomyces cerevisiae*）中工程化利用非天然底物，或合成异养（synthetic heterotrophy），代表了将丰富且可再生的碳源和能源作为生物过程输入进行增值的机会。我们先前证明，在非天然底物木糖（xylose）生长期间，激活半乳糖（galactose, GAL）调节子（一种该酵母用于在生长于半乳糖时协调底物利用与生物量形成的调控结构），与相同异源分解代谢途径的组成型过表达相比，会导致显著改变的基因表达谱和更快的生长。然而，这项工作涉及创建木糖诱导型Gal3p变体（Gal3p(Syn4.1)），即GAL调节子的传感器蛋白，这阻止了这种半合成调节子方法轻易适应其他非天然底物。在此，我们报告构建了一种变体Gal3p(MC)（代谢协调器），它在结构多样的底物存在下表现出稳健的GAL调节子激活，并重现了天然系统的动态特性。多项分子建模研究表明，Gal3p(MC)以不依赖诱导剂的方式占据对应于半乳糖结合Gal3p的构象状态。使用Gal3p(MC)测试调节子方法同化非天然木质纤维素糖类木糖、阿拉伯糖（arabinose）和纤维二糖（cellobiose），与相同分解代谢基因集的组成型过表达相比，产生了更高的生长速率和最终细胞密度。随后对这三种非天然底物快速且完全共利用的演示表明，通过GAL调节子激活介导的Gal3p(MC)动态全局基因表达变化可能对工程化合成异养具有普遍益处。
